title: Release docs test rejects unrelated version numbers in current entries
lead: The release docs test (tests/squalify.Cli.Tests/DocsTests.cs, `CurrentChangesLabelProblems`) rejects any x.y.z in a current entry's prose that is above the current Version, so a note like "needs System.Text.Json 10.0.1" under Version 1.0.1 fails with "names 10.0.1, which is newer than 1.0.1". It fails loudly and clearly, and today's entries have no such number. Decide whether to restrict the check to version-shaped mentions of squalify itself.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Reproduce with a theory case; 2. narrow the rule or document it in docs/release.md; 3. mutation-check.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Build, test and format pass; `slicer check` passes.
